capacity.title: Capacity unlocked
capacity.description: Fewer touches per claim, shorter handling time

metrics.fteNote: Time given back to your team, not a reduction in headcount.

assumptions.currentHandlingCostFormula: = Handling time x Cost per minute x Claims volume
assumptions.capacityUnlockedFormula: = Current handling cost less the handling cost after automation, where an automated claim takes 36 seconds of review and each remaining manual claim takes half the current handling time
assumptions.reworkAvoidedFormula: = Rework claims x Handling time x Rework multiplier x Cost per minute
assumptions.assumption1: Savings apply only to eligible claim categories
assumptions.assumption3: Savings reflect reduced handling effort and rework
assumptions.assumption4: 75% sensitivity adjustment applied to all projections
assumptions.assumption5: Cost per minute comes from True Aim's assumed fully loaded adjuster cost per year: CHF 95,000, EUR 55,000, USD 70,000 or ZAR 420,000, depending on the currency selected.

breakdownRows.manualClaims: Claims that still need a person

assumptions.note1: All figures shown represent gross operational impact and do not take into account the cost of True Aim's services.
assumptions.note2: Pricing is not included and is agreed per contract.
assumptions.note3: The estimator is based on data from real insurance claims and case studies with insurers.
